forecasts.question: Will Netanyahu's coalition lose its Knesset majority or dissolve early before 2026-10-27?
forecasts.delta_reason: RETIRE-OBE. Both YES-conditions definitively closed. Knesset dissolved naturally Jul 17, 2026 (first full term since 1988); natural dissolution does not satisfy the 'early dissolution' condition per the ambiguity_rule. Coalition maintained 61+ seats through mandatory date; no roll-call fell below 61. Netanyahu caretaker PM; no legal removal mechanism before Oct 27. Sunday cold-start audit: p_cold=0.01, gap=14pp — confirms zombie status. Forecast was operationally moot for 72 days. Retired Sep 27 with effective resolution NO.
forecasts.resolution_criteria: YES if a Knesset roll-call vote confirms coalition loss of majority (61 seats), OR if Netanyahu announces early dissolution and election date moves earlier than 2026-10-27. NO if coalition survives to mandatory election date with 61+ seats intact.
forecasts.resolution_source_rule: Knesset official record + Reuters/Haaretz/Times of Israel. Polling alone does not resolve.
forecasts.ambiguity_rule: If coalition drops below 61 but Netanyahu remains caretaker PM until election: YES. If a single party departs but coalition retains 61+: NO. Reviewed weekly only (Sundays); no intra-week deltas.

forecasts.question: Will Iran publicly commit to resuming mediated ceasefire negotiations (a named Iranian official or MFA announces readiness for talks) before EOD 2026-09-06?
forecasts.delta_reason: RESOLVE-NO. No Iranian readiness-for-talks declaration Sep 3–6. Active US-Iran kinetic exchange throughout: US strikes Sep 1 and 5; Iranian regional strikes Sep 1–3; IRGC 'avenge civilian deaths' posture contradicted diplomatic threshold. First contact since June occurred Sep 22 at UNGA — sixteen days after F2 horizon. Multiple TIER1 sources (Ariana News, Stars and Stripes, Bloomberg, Axios) explicitly describe Sep 22 as 'first talks since June.'
forecasts.resolution_criteria: YES if, before EOD 2026-09-06, a named Iranian official (FM Araghchi, Supreme National Security Council, or IRNA/Tasnim/Press TV quoting an official) issues a public statement committing to resuming or entering mediated ceasefire negotiations with the United States. A 'readiness for talks' declaration counts; mere written-message relay does NOT count.
forecasts.resolution_source_rule: One TIER1 (Reuters/AP/AFP/Al Jazeera) citing the named Iranian official, OR Iranian state media (IRNA/Tasnim) carrying the official statement.
forecasts.ambiguity_rule: Conditional or preconditioned offers ('will talk if US stops strikes') = AMBIGUOUS-RESOLVE-AS-NO unless the US publicly accepts the condition; a mediator asserting Iran is 'open' without a named Iranian official statement = AMBIGUOUS-RESOLVE-AS-NO.

forecasts.question: Will commercial shipping through the Strait of Hormuz reach >=30 vessels/day (7-day rolling average) before EOD 2026-10-03?
forecasts.delta_reason: Three compounding developments: (1) September Hormuz total 78 commercial transits (~2.6/day average, board-low), with Sep 20 recording one transit; CAPE DAO struck by IRGC mine Sep 23 off Musandam — fourth named commercial vessel event in September. (2) Trump explicitly rejected Iran's seven-day roadmap Sep 26 ('I'm rejecting their deal'), eliminating the only current diplomatic offramp with 6 days remaining. (3) All three indicators CONTRADICTED or NOT_OBSERVED. Mathematical impossibility: reaching 30/day 7-day rolling average from 1–4/day baseline in 6 days requires approximately 210 transits in an active IRGC mine environment. p_cold=0.02 (Sunday cold-start audit; 20pp gap confirmed; Judge decision: accept p=0.03 with 1pp premium for irreducible tail risk of surprise diplomatic reversal).
forecasts.resolution_criteria: YES if any AIS-based ship-tracking source (IMF PortWatch, Straits.live, MarineTraffic, Lloyd's List Intelligence) records >=30 commercial transits/day as a 7-day rolling average at any point between 2026-09-03 and 2026-10-03.
forecasts.resolution_source_rule: AIS-based tracker + one TIER1 or OSINT confirmation (Bloomberg/Reuters/Lloyd's List).
forecasts.ambiguity_rule: If two independent AIS-based tracking services (Straits.live, MarineTraffic, or Lloyd's List Intelligence) record rolling 7-day commercial transit averages that differ by more than 20% from each other, resolution uses the lower of the two readings. 'Commercial transit' means tankers, bulk carriers, and container ships under commercial purpose; naval vessels, fishing vessels, and vessels in distress do not count. A single-day spike to >=30 without a sustained 7-day rolling average >=30 = NOT_OBSERVED.

Channel 13 shows Likud 18 with Eisenkot bloc at 52–51 overall. i24NEWS outlier: Likud 27. First-time voters: Yashar 16% vs Likud 14%. p_cold=0.37; gap=5pp, within tolerance (no mandatory flag). forecasts.question: Will the IRGC or Iran-affiliated forces conduct a confirmed attack on a commercial vessel or US/allied military asset in the Gulf region before EOD 2026-10-01?
forecasts.delta_reason: New forecast opened Sep 27. Priced on September base rate of approximately one named IRGC-attributable incident per seven days (CAPE DAO Sep 23 most recent; EL GAIA preceding). No IRGC restraint signal appeared post-UNGA roadmap rejection on Sep 26. CENTCOM maintains forward posture in Gulf. No tactical pause declared. Four-day horizon makes base-rate calculation relatively mechanical.
forecasts.resolution_criteria: YES if CENTCOM, UK Maritime Trade Operations (UKMTO), a named Gulf state defense ministry, or a TIER1 source (Reuters/AP/AFP/Bloomberg) reports a confirmed IRGC or IRGC-affiliated attack on a commercial vessel or US/allied military asset in the Strait of Hormuz, Persian Gulf, or Gulf of Oman between 2026-09-27 and 2026-10-01 inclusive. Houthi attacks in Hormuz/Gulf of Oman context count; Red Sea-only attacks do NOT.
forecasts.resolution_source_rule: CENTCOM or UKMTO advisory, OR two independent TIER1 sources. OSINT-only (AIS anomaly without official confirmation) = AMBIGUOUS-RESOLVE-AS-NO.
forecasts.ambiguity_rule: Attacks attributed to unnamed 'unknown actor' without IRGC/proxy attribution confirmed by at least one named authority = AMBIGUOUS-RESOLVE-AS-NO. A mine detonation without confirmed IRGC provenance within the window = AMBIGUOUS. Drone/missile intercept by CENTCOM attributed to IRGC counts as YES regardless of whether the attack caused damage.

forecasts.question: Will CENTCOM announce a new sustained bombing campaign against targets inside Iran before EOD 2026-11-03 (day before US midterm elections)?

CENTCOM carrier strike group not yet at surge posture. Iran has not conducted a large IRGC barrage killing US personnel. Diplomatic track formally closed Sep 26 but no US bombing-mandate announcement issued. 37-day window with midterm political constraint produces p=0.15.
forecasts.resolution_criteria: YES if CENTCOM or Pentagon publicly confirms airstrikes against IRGC or Iranian military infrastructure inside Iranian territory on at least 3 consecutive calendar days between 2026-09-27 and 2026-11-03.

A two-day strike sequence that pauses and resumes after a 48-hour gap does NOT count as '3 consecutive days.' Israeli unilateral strikes on Iran without US co-announcement do NOT count.

forecasts.question: Will the United States and Iran publicly announce a formal ceasefire agreement or new Memorandum of Understanding before EOD 2026-12-31?
forecasts.delta_reason: New forecast opened Sep 27. Priced on 95-day window, post-midterm US policy review potential (Bloomberg Sep 26 implies Trump reassessment window after Nov 4), and non-trivial probability of a materially revised Iranian proposal under sustained economic compression. Trump's Sep 26 rejection closes the near-term track but not the 95-day horizon. Opening price capped at 0.22 given Trump's documented rejection posture, active IRGC mine campaign, and requirement for named-official confirmation on both sides. YES criteria require official US-side statement — not rhetorical; Iranian FM statement without US confirmation = AMBIGUOUS-RESOLVE-AS-NO.
forecasts.resolution_criteria: YES if a joint or parallel public announcement by named senior US officials (Secretary of Defense, National Security Advisor, or President) AND named Iranian officials (President, FM Araghchi, or SNSC) of a formal ceasefire, armistice, or new Memorandum of Understanding for cessation of hostilities is published before EOD December 31, 2026. Carried by two independent TIER1 sources.
forecasts.resolution_source_rule: Reuters or AP lead story plus one additional TIER1 confirming named officials on both sides. A unilateral US announcement without Iranian confirmation = AMBIGUOUS-RESOLVE-AS-NO.
forecasts.ambiguity_rule: Tactical pause lasting fewer than 7 days without named-official framing as 'ceasefire' or 'MOU' = AMBIGUOUS-RESOLVE-AS-NO. Ceasefire applying only to Hormuz without broader hostilities halt = AMBIGUOUS — resolve as YES only if both sides describe it as ceasefire/MOU in official statements. Iranian FM statement without named US-side confirmation = AMBIGUOUS-RESOLVE-AS-NO.
